_comment: 示例配置（非必需）：首次运行会自动生成 %APPDATA%\VSManager\settings.json；如需预置，可复制本文件到该位置后修改。以 _comment 开头的字段会被忽略。
_comment_secrets: AgentKeyProtected / VoiceKeyProtected / GitHubTokenProtected / WebToken 请保持空字符串，切勿填写明文。Key 可在「属性」中填写（DPAPI 加密保存，仅本机当前用户可解密），或改用环境变量 VSMANAGER_AGENT_API_KEY / VSMANAGER_DOUBAO_API_KEY / VSMANAGER_GITHUB_TOKEN；WebToken 为空时自动生成。
_comment_archive: ArchiveRoot 为空时依次使用环境变量 VSMANAGER_ARCHIVE_ROOT、%APPDATA%\VSManager\archive；支持 %环境变量% 写法。ArchiveRetentionDays 为 0 表示永久保留。
_comment_memory: 内存面板的超阈值策略默认关闭；VsMemoryThresholdMB 按单个 VS 及其子进程的工作集合计（默认 6144），VsMemoryAutoClean=false 表示只提示。 The memory threshold policy is off by default; VsMemoryThresholdMB is the working set of one VS with its child processes (default 6144); VsMemoryAutoClean=false means notify only.
_comment_restart: AI 助手自动重启默认开启：内部异常、请求连续失败 AgentFailureThreshold 次（默认 3）或 AgentHangTimeoutSeconds 秒无进展（默认 120）时自动重建；进程看门狗 ProcessWatchdogEnabled 默认关闭；防重启风暴 AutoRestartWindowMinutes 分钟内最多 AutoRestartMaxCount 次（默认 5 分钟 3 次）。 AI assistant auto-restart is on by default: it is rebuilt after an internal error, AgentFailureThreshold consecutive request failures (default 3) or AgentHangTimeoutSeconds without progress (default 120); the process watchdog ProcessWatchdogEnabled is off by default; storm guard: at most AutoRestartMaxCount restarts per AutoRestartWindowMinutes (default 3 per 5 min).
_comment_chat: AI 助手对话记录只保存在本机 %APPDATA%\VSManager\agent-chat.jsonl；AgentChatKeepDays（默认 30 天）与 AgentChatMaxRecords（默认 2000 条）超出时裁剪最旧的记录，0 表示不限制。 The AI assistant chat history is stored only in %APPDATA%\VSManager\agent-chat.jsonl; the oldest records beyond AgentChatKeepDays (default 30) or AgentChatMaxRecords (default 2000) are trimmed, 0 = no limit.
_comment_solutions: 解决方案登记表单独保存在 %APPDATA%\VSManager\solutions.json。SolutionCloseConfirm（默认 true）AI 关闭 VS 前总是确认；SolutionOpenWaitSeconds（默认 90，范围 10–600）打开解决方案后等待 VS 出现的秒数；PendingVsSettleSeconds（默认 20，范围 0–300）暂存任务在目标 VS 出现后再等待的秒数；PendingVsNotify（默认 true）暂存 / 推送时通知并播报。 The solution registry is stored separately in %APPDATA%\VSManager\solutions.json. SolutionCloseConfirm (default true): always confirm before the AI closes a VS; SolutionOpenWaitSeconds (default 90, range 10–600): seconds to wait for VS after opening a solution; PendingVsSettleSeconds (default 20, range 0–300): extra wait after a parked task's VS appears; PendingVsNotify (default true): notify and speak when tasks are parked / pushed.
_comment_resend: AutoHideResentFailedTasks（默认 true）同一任务重新发布时只在界面隐藏原失败条目，tasks.json 与归档不变；AutoHideResentFailedNotify（默认 true）隐藏时通知并播报；HiddenResentTasks 由程序维护，无需填写。 AutoHideResentFailedTasks (default true): when the same task is published again, hide the original failed entry in the UI only (tasks.json and the archive stay untouched); AutoHideResentFailedNotify (default true): notify and speak when doing so; HiddenResentTasks is maintained by the app and need not be set.
_comment_send: 发送确认：SendConfirmTimeoutSeconds（默认 10，范围 2–120）写入输入框后的确认超时；SendLocateTimeoutSeconds（默认 6，范围 1–60）每轮定位 Copilot 输入框的轮询超时；SendAutoRetry（默认 true）是否自动重试，同时控制粘贴确认与输入框定位；SendRetryCount（默认 1，范围 0–5）粘贴未确认时的重试次数；SendLocateRetryCount（默认 1，范围 0–5）未找到输入框时重新打开窗格并重试的次数。 Send confirmation: SendConfirmTimeoutSeconds (default 10, range 2–120) is the confirmation timeout after writing to the input box; SendLocateTimeoutSeconds (default 6, range 1–60) is the polling timeout of each round locating the Copilot input box; SendAutoRetry (default true) enables automatic retries for both paste confirmation and input locating; SendRetryCount (default 1, range 0–5) retries an unconfirmed paste; SendLocateRetryCount (default 1, range 0–5) reopens the pane and retries when the input box is not found.
_comment_en: Example config (optional): %APPDATA%\VSManager\settings.json is created on first run; copy this file there only if you want to pre-seed it. Fields starting with _comment are ignored. Keep AgentKeyProtected / VoiceKeyProtected / GitHubTokenProtected / WebToken empty and never put plain-text secrets here: enter keys in Settings (DPAPI-encrypted) or use VSMANAGER_AGENT_API_KEY / VSMANAGER_DOUBAO_API_KEY / VSMANAGER_GITHUB_TOKEN. Empty ArchiveRoot falls back to VSMANAGER_ARCHIVE_ROOT, then %APPDATA%\VSManager\archive; ArchiveRetentionDays 0 keeps archives forever.
VoiceSpeaker: 年轻女声，普通话，语气轻快清晰
VoiceSpeakerEn: A young female voice speaking clear American English in a light, cheerful tone
